newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RNA Holdings IPO seen 29 times subscribed -sources.
newsitem.headline: RNA Holdings IPO seen 29 times subscribed -sources.

text.p: Hong Kong flotation of shares of RNA Holdings Ltd, a spinoff of Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd, is expected to be 29 times subscribed at the close of its public subscription on Friday, market sources said.
An official announcement on the subscription results will be released on November 27 and dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on December 2.
RNA offered 168 million new shares at HK$1.01 each in an initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong.
Tem Fat Hing Hung is a bullion and jewellery trader while RNA engages in refining, casting, assaying and wholesaling precious metals.
